title: Canonical right-tensor presentation of restricted reduction
statement: Use [def-weil-pbc-residue-exchange-comparison-interface]. For every scheme T construct a specific natural isomorphism residueExchangeReduction(T) followed by exact residue restriction S_T ≅ tensorRight(B_T), where B_T is the restricted residue regular module in degree zero. The construction is determined by the ordinary balanced tensor presentation, the extension-adjunction counit, uniqueness of left derived functors, and derived symmetry; it is not an arbitrary witness of an existence assertion. The construction uses the existing explicit left-derived tensor counit from [lem-weil-pbc-integral-reduction-tensor]. Exact restriction S_T is the wrapper in [new-integral-residue-derived-pull-square].

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Import the proved canonical balanced tensor and left-derived counit API from IntegralReductionTensor (lem-weil-pbc-integral-reduction-tensor). This is the single existing proof of integral linearity, the ordinary tensor isomorphism, the homotopy comparison and its canonical derived counit; do not repeat these declarations.

Use tensorPresentationDerivedCounit_isLeftDerivedFunctor for the specific exposed counit. Uniqueness of left derived functors identifies this restricted scalar extension with the left-derived tensor functor; the comparison is fixed by that counit.

Identify derived tensor with a single degree-zero object using BifunctorSingle, the quotient's strong monoidal comparison, and localization uniqueness. Use symmetry in the generic derived category to put the coefficient on the right, and specialize to integral residue reduction.

Keep the standard single/quotient comparison and derived braiding as explicit named data. The defining left-derived comparison equation gives derivedTensorPresentationIso_fac. Specialize the balanced counit and its proved left-derived property to the named residue reduction/restriction functor. Its named data unfold to the same original canonical constructor.

noncomputable def residueExchangeTensorIso (T : Scheme.{u}) :
    letI : MonoidalCategory (residueExchangeDerived (integralCoeff ℓ E) T) :=
      CategoryTheory.tensorPresentationMonoidal
    residueExchangeReduction ℓ E T ⋙ residueExchangeRestriction ℓ E T ≅
      tensorRight (residueExchangeCoefficient ℓ E T)
